The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/pon/copyright.htm):
> The New Testament and Psalms in the Pohnpeian language of the Federated States of Micronesia (old translation, using old alphabet)
> Public Domain
> Language: Pohnpeian
> 2023-07-17

What was found:
Text: the New Testament and Psalms in old Pohnpeian spelling; eBible's file name says 1922, and no translator is named anywhere reached.

Why it stays out: missing fact: the death year of A. (Adam) Syring, who translated and revised this 1935 American Bible Society New Testament and Psalms, and the names and death years of the Pohnpeian teachers who helped him.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=pon), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/pon/copyright.htm), https://ebible.org/pdf/pon/pon_prt.pdf.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
